buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for resin loading

salt_name.description: Name/identity of the salt in the loading buffer

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as provided in eLabFTW)

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used during loading (units as configured on instrument)

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition on the plate

resin_mass.description: Mass of resin used per condition

ligand_name.description: Name/identity of the ligand loaded onto the resin

total_volume.description: Total volume of ligand solution per well

incubation_time.description: Incubation time after loading before measurement

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used on the plate (ordering matches columns)

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles before loading

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations used on the plate (ordering matches rows)

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve converting absorbance to concentration

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations (e.g. mM, µM)

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve converting absorbance to concentration

equilibration_cycle_duration.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations on the plate

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations on the plate

analysis_status.description: Status of the Tecan loading isotherm analysis

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

summary.description: Key metrics aggregated from analysis outputs

n_points_raw.description: Number of raw well-level data points extracted from the plate

qmax_values.description: List of fitted qmax values across salt conditions (may contain nulls if fit failed)

K_values.description: List of fitted Langmuir affinity constants K across salt conditions (may contain nulls)

R2_values.description: List of Langmuir fit R² values across salt conditions (may contain nulls)

data_files.description: Output data file names produced by analysis

plots.description: Output plot file names produced by analysis

raw_analysis.description: Raw JSON contents of analysis_results_{elab_id}.json for full traceability
